column2: Sold {tonnes} of {resource} for {amount} to balance the ledger this month.
Automatic sales moved {tonnes} of {resource} this month for {amount}.
Daily auto-sell is active for {resource}. Everything above {reserve} sells whenever the price hits {price}/t or more.
Auto-sell is off. {resource} is sold by hand only.
On: at each month end, just enough ore is sold to cover storage and loan payments, keeping cash at zero or above.
Off: ending the month with cash below zero counts toward bankruptcy, even if the warehouse is full.
Storage is running {amount} a month, eating a large share of your cash. Sell ore or set an auto-sell policy on the Market tab.
Set the reserve in tonnes to keep on the pile, such as 0 or 2,500.
Set the floor price per tonne to accept, such as 0 or 850.
Cover costs at month end turns on tomorrow.
Cover costs at month end turns off tomorrow.
Zero in either field means no limit. Automatic sales are tallied in the ledger once a month.
